title: Studio Configuration

environment.label: Server Environment
environment.tagInfo: Apply a tag to the Studio indicating the server environment.
environment.noEffectInfo: This does not affect any settings or features.

replicationFactor.label: Default Replication Factor
replicationFactor.defaultInfo: Set the default replication factor when creating a new database.
replicationFactor.clusterSizeInfo: If not set, then the number of nodes in your cluster will be used.
replicationFactor.addNodesInfo: Additional nodes can always be added to the database after it is created.

tableFont.label: Table Font
tableFont.info: Choose the font used for displaying data in tables across the Studio, including document IDs, column values, and other tabular content.

codeFont.label: Code Font
codeFont.info: Choose the font used for displaying code across the Studio, including code editors and samples.

usageStatsSwitch: Help improve the Studio by gathering anonymous usage statistics

about.scopeDetails: The available studio-configuration options will apply server-wide to all databases.
about.environmentPerDatabase: The environment tag can be customized per database in the Database Studio-Configuration view.
